name: app/form-field
title: FormField
summary: Label, control, hint and error wired together: the label is always visible, the hint and error are the control's description, and an error sets aria-invalid. The control is an input, a textarea, a native select, a checkbox, a switch or a radio group.

props.name: name
props.description: The field name; the id is `field-<name>`.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value. For a checkbox or a switch it is the value posted when checked (default "on"); for a radio group, the option that is checked.

props.name: type
props.description: Input type (an input only). A file input never carries a value.

props.name: as
props.description: The control: an input, a textarea, a native select, a checkbox, a switch (a checkbox with role="switch") or a radio group (a fieldset of native radios from `options`).

props.name: options
props.description: A select's or a radio group's options; the one whose value is `value` is selected (checked).

props.name: checked
props.description: A checkbox or a switch that starts checked.

props.name: emptyOption
props.description: A select's first, empty option (e.g. "Choose a type"), selected when there is no value.

props.name: rows
props.description: A textarea's rows.

props.name: accept
props.description: A file input's accepted types (e.g. "image/*").

props.name: multiple
props.description: A file input that takes several files.

props.name: min
props.description: Lowest value of a number or date input.

props.name: max
props.description: Highest value of a number or date input.

props.name: step
props.description: Step of a number or date input.

props.name: wide
props.description: Spans both of FormLayout's columns (`@xl:col-span-2`).

props.name: hint
props.description: Help under the field.

props.name: error
props.description: The error under the field.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the label (or the legend) "(required)" and the control required. A required checkbox must be checked; a required radio group must have one choice.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Read-only, on a muted fill. A select, a checkbox, a switch and a radio group are disabled instead (they have no read-only state), so they are not posted.

props.name: autocomplete
props.description: Autocomplete token.

props.name: maxlength
props.description: Maximum length.

props.name: inputmode
props.description: Virtual keyboard hint.

behaviour: "(required)" is written in the label, not shown by an asterisk alone.
aria-describedby lists the hint and then the error.
A textarea and a select get the same id, name, required, aria-describedby and aria-invalid as an input, at the same app density.
A select with `emptyOption` starts with an empty option, selected when there is no value.
A file input never carries a value; its file-selector button is a muted pill. With a file field, FormLayout needs `enctype="multipart/form-data"`.

A checkbox and a switch are a native <input type="checkbox"> inside their <label>, before the label text, so the whole row is the hit area; a switch adds role="switch" and is drawn as a pill track whose thumb moves to the end when on (the position says the state, not colour alone). They get the same id, name, required, aria-describedby and aria-invalid as an input, and post `value` (default "on") when checked.

A radio group is a <fieldset> whose <legend> is the label (with "(required)"), one native <input type="radio"> per option inside its own <label>; the option whose value is `value` is checked. The fieldset carries aria-describedby; each radio carries required and aria-invalid.
A choice row is 36px tall on a fine pointer and 48px on touch; checked controls use the shell's accent (`--app-accent`, else `--primary`).

textarea.description: A textarea with a hint and an error.

select.description: A select with an empty first option and no value.

select-readonly.description: A read-only select with a value: disabled, its option selected.

file.description: A file input for several images, spanning both columns.

checkbox.description: A required checkbox with a hint and an error.

props.name: terms
props.label: I accept the listing terms
props.hint: You can withdraw at any time.

switch.description: A switch that starts on, posting "yes".

props.name: notify
props.label: Email me about new reviews
props.hint: At most one email a day.

radio-group.description: A required radio group with a value.

choice-readonly.description: A read-only switch: disabled, still checked.

keyboard: Native input, textarea, select, checkbox and radio: Space toggles a checkbox or switch, arrow keys move between radios.
aria: role="switch" on a switch, which announces on/off.
A radio group is a fieldset named by its legend.

theming.brandOverlay: The focus ring follows the brand's `--ring`, and a checked checkbox, switch or radio takes the shell's accent (`--app-accent`, else `--primary`). Nothing else changes: layout, spacing, type and every other colour are the same in every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: Fills its column; 16px text on touch so iOS never zooms.
`wide` spans both columns of FormLayout's container grid from @xl.
contract:
contract
  slot is "form-field"
  uses label
  uses input
  when default shows label "(required)"
  when textarea class contains "@xl:col-span-2"
  when file class contains "@xl:col-span-2"
  when checkbox shows label "I accept the listing terms"
  when switch shows label "Email me about new reviews"
  when radio-group shows legend "Role"
  when radio-group class contains "@xl:col-span-2"
end

checks.say: The input is described by hint and error.
The label points at the input.
No error, no aria-invalid.
A textarea is wired as an input is.
The textarea's label points at it.
A select is wired as an input is.
The empty option comes first and is selected with no value.
Every option is rendered.
A read-only select is disabled, its value selected.
Without emptyOption there is no empty option.
A file input takes types and several files, and never a value.
A number input carries its bounds.
A checkbox is a native checkbox inside its label, wired as an input is.
The checkbox's label says it is required.
A switch is a checkbox with role=switch, checked, posting its value.
A switch is a pill.
A checkbox field has no other control.
A radio group is a fieldset described by its hint.
The legend is the label and says it is required.
One native radio per option, each in its label.
The value's option is checked.
Only one option is checked.
A read-only switch is disabled and keeps its state.
